audience: A stage manager with a damaged set piece.
positioning: A repair shop that lets the stage manager see the plan before approving work.
decision: Review the proposed type and palette. Supply the original logo for external release.

sources.excerpt: A photo starts the job. The shop inspects the joint and sends a plan for approval.
Turnaround figures are internal and apply to one tour. Dates require inspection.

voice.rule: Name the part or action a stage manager recognizes.
voice.after: Send a photo of the break.

voice.rule: Describe the next decision. Give a completion date only after inspection.
voice.before: Get your set back in two days.
voice.after: Review the repair plan before work starts.

visual.rule: Keep the site's dark ink on a warm paper field.
Use the company name in type until an approved logo arrives. Trial Georgia with #29251E on #FFFCF3. The exact font and colors are proposed.
Stack the three steps in order with matching line icons, a short label and one sentence each. Stay under the owner's 55-word limit.

sheet.headline: Show us the break.
sheet.intro: Start a set repair with a photo.

cards.label: Review the plan
cards.text: You approve the repair before work starts.
